title: A1: mimid-agent-core library: the client engine factored out of mimid-chat's JMAP mode
description: Plan 2026-11-16 (transport decided: loopback HTTP + token + EventSource). Extract from tools/interop/chat (jmap.rs, state.rs and the JMAP-mode paths of chat.rs) into crates/mimid-agent-core: identity and mimi-mls Member state (SQLite), the outward JMAP client to the mimid server (KeyPackage/set, Room/create with roomId, KeyMaterial/fetch, Room/update, Room/send, Room/unbind, GroupInfo/fetch, Consent/set, Message/changes polling), FanoutMessage processing (Welcome, Commit, application message), mimi-content encode/decode. No terminal, no HTTP server, no tokio runtime ownership (mobile embedding, mimid-1wgh.39). mimid-chat keeps working on top of it (its hub-mode/Haven-lane paths stay in the tool). Carries .13.7's rule: update bundles send RatchetTreeOption distributionService.
